title: The First Adolescent Super-Earth-Sized Multi-Planet System Around an M Dwarf: TOI-2079
byline: Peláez-Torres; Pozuelos; F J; Esparza-Borges; Morello; Dévora-Pajares; Gkouvelis; Vissapragada; Rojas-Ayala; Burgasser; A J; Rackham; B V; Tamburo; Orell-Miquel
html:
Abstract:We identify two planets in close-in orbits around the M-type star TOI-2079 as the first super-Earth-sized planets orbiting a multi-planet M dwarf with a well-determined age of $1$-$2$\,Gyr. The interior planet, TOI-2079 b, has an orbital period of $1.49232359^{+0.00000099}_{-0.00000086}$ d, and the outer planet, TOI-2079 c, has an orbital period of $9.3174523\pm0.0000098$ d. The host star characterization is based on spectroscopic observations, which classify it from an M1.5 to an M3.5 dwarf with an effective temperature of $3695\pm77$ K. Further analysis determined TOI-2079's rotation period to be $17.33^{+0.29}_{-0.28}$ d. Multiple ground-based follow-up observations, combined with a state-of-the-art validation procedure, allow us to rule out possible astrophysical false-positive scenarios and validate the planetary nature of both objects. We find that the inner planet has a radius of $1.320\pm0.050 R_{\oplus}$ and $T_{\rm eq} = 867\pm27$ K, while the outer planet has $R_{\rm p} = 1.671\pm0.051 R_{\oplus}$ and $T_{\rm eq} = 473\pm15$ K.
